implementation_summary: Daily bias phase 1 map for D bias, active 1H C1/C2/C3 structure near the daily POI, and 5m continuation refinement inside hourly Candle 3.

source_priority.policy: Use TTrades videos first. Use docs only to clarify missing details or unresolved mismatches.
notes: Video corpus is the primary authority for this MVP.
No docs were required for clarification in this refresh.

display_contract.unsupported_timeframe_message: Unsupported chart timeframe. Load this indicator on a 1H chart.

inputs.description: Show the current daily bias banner.
Show the active daily POI zone on the hourly chart.
Show the active 1H C1/C2/C3 labels and entry guide when they form inside the daily POI, otherwise show one small waiting cue while the 5m refinement stays alert-driven only.

qualification: Establish a one-sided daily bias from daily closures before dropping to the hourly chart.
A daily close through the previous day structure supports continuation; failure to close through supports reversal bias.
If there is no clear daily bias, do not continue to the hourly execution read.

qualification: Project the previous day range and equilibrium onto the hourly chart and treat the aligned half of that range as the daily POI.
For bullish daily bias, use the lower half of the previous day range as the retracement zone.
For bearish daily bias, use the upper half of the previous day range as the retracement zone.
daily_poi_rules.bullish_poi_definition: Bullish daily POI is bounded by the previous day low and previous day equilibrium.
daily_poi_rules.bearish_poi_definition: Bearish daily POI is bounded by the previous day equilibrium and previous day high.

hourly_sequence_rules.activation_start: Activate hourly structure only after the daily bias is present and the hourly Candle 2 forms inside the daily POI.
hourly_sequence_rules.activation_end: End the active hourly sequence when the daily POI loses relevance or the hourly map is invalidated.
hourly_sequence_rules.c1_definition: Hourly Candle 1 is the bar immediately before the swing-point bar.
hourly_sequence_rules.c2_definition: Hourly Candle 2 is the swing bar that prints at or inside the daily POI and closes in the direction of the daily bias.
hourly_sequence_rules.c3_definition: Hourly Candle 3 is the next hourly bar after Candle 2 and represents the expected immediate follow-through.
hourly_sequence_rules.entry_guidance: When Candle 2 is confirmed inside the daily POI, the phase-1 entry guide is the open of hourly Candle 3 in the direction of the daily bias.
hourly_sequence_rules.waiting_guidance: If Candle 2 has not formed yet, show only one small cue that tells the trader which Candle 2 direction to wait for inside the daily POI.

gating_rules.hourly_poi_filter: Only print hourly C1/C2/C3 if Candle 2 forms inside the active daily POI band.
gating_rules.invalidation: Reset the active hourly sequence when price closes back through the opposite side of the daily POI or when the daily bias is no longer actionable.

acceptance_checks: The script only supports 1H charts and shows a clear message otherwise.
Daily bias is shown without targets, ladders, dashboards, or lower-timeframe overlays.
The daily POI zone is visible on the hourly chart.
Hourly C1/C2/C3 labels only appear when the hourly sequence forms inside the daily POI.
Entry guide appears at the open of hourly Candle 3 when the sequence activates.
Five-minute continuation confirmation is derived only after the hourly sequence activates and is emitted through rule states or alerts rather than a second on-chart candle map.
When no hourly sequence is active, a single waiting cue shows the next Candle 2 direction to watch for inside the daily POI.
Only the current active hourly sequence is visible.
